cd /app/work && cat > limits_test.py << 'PYEOF'
import json
from driver import run

def mk(evts):
    return {"op":"replay","inputs":[[[7]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":evts}

# 1 send + 2047 duplicates -> exactly 2048 pending: OK
ev = [["send",0,0]] + [["duplicate",0] for _ in range(2047)]
rows,_ = run(json.dumps(mk(ev)))
r = rows[0]
assert "error" not in r, r
assert len(r["packets"]) == 2048, len(r["packets"])
assert r["packets"][-1]["id"] == 2047
print("2048 pending -> accepted, packets listed:", len(r["packets"]))

# 1 send + 2048 duplicates -> 2049 pending -> E_LIMIT for the whole request
ev = [["send",0,0]] + [["duplicate",0] for _ in range(2048)]
rows,_ = run(json.dumps(mk(ev)))
assert rows[0] == {"error":"E_LIMIT"}, rows[0]
print("2049 pending -> E_LIMIT")

# creation-limit: fill buffer with full entries then flood retries
# (pending limit will bind first; both are E_LIMIT)
inputs = [[[1]*1 for _ in range(20)] for _ in range(2)]
ev = []
for r in range(2):
    for q in range(20):
        ev.append(["send", r, q])
ev.append(["deliver",0])
rows,_ = run(json.dumps({"op":"replay","inputs":inputs,"slots":20,"window":20,"events":ev}))
print("big buffer request ok:", len(rows))

# 20000 events allowed; 20001 rejected
ev = [["send",0,0]] + [["duplicate",0] for _ in range(19999)]
rows,_ = run(json.dumps(mk(ev)))
assert "error" not in rows[0]
ev2 = ev + [["duplicate",0]]
rows,_ = run(json.dumps(mk(ev2)))
assert rows[0] == {"error":"E_LIMIT"}, rows[0]
print("events 20000 ok / 20001 E_LIMIT")

# disabled send when window exhausted; enabled again after progress
req = {"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1],[2]]],"slots":2,"window":1,
       "events":[["send",0,0],["send",0,1],["deliver",0],["deliver",1],["send",0,1]]}
rows,_ = run(json.dumps(req))
st = [e["status"] for e in rows[0]["events"]]
cr = [e["created"] for e in rows[0]["events"]]
assert st == ["ok","disabled","ok","ok","ok"], st
print("window gating statuses:", st, "created:", cr)
PYEOF
python3 limits_test.py
